composition.layout: horizontal banding: glazed service window centered upper-middle, full-width counter across mid-frame, dense item grid anchored lower-center, machinery and props clustered at left/right margins

lighting.direction: diffuse ambient top-light with localized emissive panels and screens
lighting.contrast: low-to-medium, soft shadow blocks instead of gradients
lighting.ambience: dim enclosed interior, cool desaturated cast punctuated by warm accent glows

shapeLanguage: small rounded corners only on handheld props and buttons
environment: stacked sacks and crates at edges
characterStyle: medium pixel granularity with clustered shade steps
minimal dark rim separation from background
flat color blocks with dithered transitions
constraints: strict uniform pixel grid, no smooth anti-aliasing; transitions via dithering or step shading
palette locked to desaturated teal-gray dominance; warm orange/cream accents limited to under 15% area
composition must remain rectilinear panel-based with horizontal banding
all props silhouette-read with 1px darker rim
no pure black or pure white; shadows stay tinted green-gray
keep frontal orthographic staging, never introduce perspective
